tieu_de: Python / AI Developer Middle Above - Infrastructure
mo_ta_cong_viec:
The company is scaling up its intake and delivery of AI/Python application projects for clients. This role requires a Python/AI Developer with hands-on, real-world experience and strong ability to work independently — directly developing AI products/features, taking over and operating part of the infrastructure (Infra), and providing technical support to other team members when needed.
Key Responsibilities
Directly develop Python applications for AI/AI projects (chatbots, LLM integration, RAG, etc.).
Integrate APIs from AI platforms (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.) into client systems.
Independently design implementation-level architecture for assigned features/projects, only needing to align with the AI Technical Lead at a high level rather than requiring detailed day-to-day guidance.
Takeover, operate, and be able to improve the existing infrastructure (Infra): server configuration, deployment, basic CI/CD, system monitoring.
Ensure code quality and write clear technical documentation to reduce dependency on any single individual within the team.
Provide technical support and code review for other team members when needed (especially for new Python/AI projects handled by others).
Participate in direct technical discussions with clients when needed, including when the AI Technical Lead is unavailable.
Reports to AI Technical Lead
yeu_cau:
Requirements
At least 3–5 years of hands-on Python development experience in a real-world environment (production experience preferred, not only academic/training projects).
Has independently delivered at least 1–2 real-world AI/GenAI/LLM projects (chatbot, RAG, AI model integration, etc.) — an important requirement, as this role works independently with limited close supervision.
Able to independently design system architecture at a basic-to-intermediate level without needing step-by-step guidance.
Experience with Infra/DevOps: Linux servers, Docker, CI/CD, production deployment.
Highly self-driven, able to work independently, self-learn, and troubleshoot technical issues.
Good communication skills, able to discuss technical topics directly with clients when needed.
Good English proficiency for reading technical/requirement documentation and speaking
Nice-to-have
Prior experience as a Tech Lead or mentor for other developers.
Experience working on outsourcing projects for Japanese clients.
Experience with FastAPI/Django.
Relevant AI/Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure AI, etc.).
Japanese and English certifications (e.g., JLPT for Japanese, TOEIC/IELTS/TOEFL for English).
quyen_loi:
Opportunities to work directly with experts

Active study sessions (we've been running seminars frequently lately, so I can explain more about that)
Opportunity to communicate in Japanese/English with native Japanese speakers.
Remote working fully.
Social insurance, regular health check-ups, 13th month salary according to Vietnamese law.
